title: A good introduction to Morocco
text: There were a lot of highlights and a few low points. The people we met, the guides and service we received in the towns and our drivers were all excellent. The low point was the last minute change of itinerary as we were about to board the ferry in Tarifa that we later realised didn’t make sense. Naturanda provided excellent support through the Viator messaging app and were very responsive, both during and before the trip. The tour in Tangier was very ‘touristy’ but Rashid the guide in Tangier was fantastic and extremely helpful
author: LynJones
